knowledge:
- key_parameters: path1=Path to the feature CSV file containing non-negative abundance/expression values ;; path2=Path to the group CSV file containing subject grouping/covariate information ;; feature=A matrix of non-negative feature values (e.g., gene expression or protein abundance) where rows are features and columns are samples/cells ;; colData=A data frame containing grouping/covariate information where rownames must match the column names of the feature matrix
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation
- when_to_use: Use when performing differential abundance or expression analysis on mass spectrometry (proteomics/metabolomics) or single-cell RNA-seq data that contain a large fraction of zero values and where the non-zero values are potentially non-normally distributed
- pitfalls: The first column in the feature CSV must represent feature names and the first row must represent subject codes ;; The first column in the group CSV must represent subject codes ;; For matrix input, the rownames of the colData data frame must match the column names of the feature matrix ;; All values in the feature matrix or CSV must be non-negative

workflows.name: csv_to_sda
workflows.intent: Create a SummarizedExperiment object from feature and group CSV files and perform semi-parametric differential abundance analysis.
input: feature.csv (matrix of non-negative feature abundances with feature names in the first column and subject codes in the first row)
group.csv (subject grouping/covariate information with subject codes in the first column)
workflows.stages: 1. Define paths to the feature and group CSV files ;; 2. Load the SDAMS library ;; 3. Create a SummarizedExperiment object using createSEFromCSV ;; 4. Perform differential abundance analysis using SDA ;; 5. Extract results for gamma (zero proportion), beta (non-zero abundance), and the two-part test
workflows.code:
directory1 <- system.file("extdata", package = "SDAMS", mustWork = TRUE)
path1 <- file.path(directory1, "ProstateFeature.csv")
directory2 <- system.file("extdata", package = "SDAMS", mustWork = TRUE)
path2 <- file.path(directory2, "ProstateGroup.csv")
library("SDAMS")
exampleSE1 <- createSEFromCSV(path1, path2)
results <- SDA(exampleSE1)
head(results$gamma[,1])
head(results$pv_gamma[,1])
head(results$qv_gamma[,1])
head(results$beta[,1])
head(results$pv_beta[,1])
head(results$qv_beta[,1])
head(results$pv_2part[,1])
head(results$qv_2part[,1])
head(results$feat.names)

workflows.name: matrix_to_sda
workflows.intent: Create a SummarizedExperiment object from in-memory feature and covariate matrices and perform semi-parametric differential expression analysis.
input: featureInfo (matrix of non-negative expression values where rows are features/genes and columns are cells/subjects)
groupInfo (data frame of grouping/covariate information with rownames matching the column names of featureInfo)
workflows.stages: 1. Create a SummarizedExperiment object from the feature matrix and covariate data frame using createSEFromMatrix ;; 2. Perform differential expression analysis using SDA ;; 3. Extract results for gamma, beta, and the two-part test
workflows.code:
set.seed(100)
featureInfo <- matrix(runif(8000, -2, 5), ncol = 40)
featureInfo[featureInfo<0] <- 0
rownames(featureInfo) <- paste("gene", 1:200, sep = '')
colnames(featureInfo) <- paste('cell', 1:40, sep = '')
groupInfo <- data.frame(grouping=matrix(sample(0:1, 40, replace = TRUE),
                        ncol = 1))
rownames(groupInfo) <- colnames(featureInfo)
exampleSE2 <- createSEFromMatrix(feature = featureInfo, colData = groupInfo)
results_SC <- SDA(exampleSE2)
head(results_SC$pv_gamma[,1])
head(results_SC$qv_gamma[,1])
head(results_SC$pv_beta[,1])
head(results_SC$qv_beta[,1])
head(results_SC$pv_2part[,1])
head(results_SC$qv_2part[,1])
head(results_SC$feat.names)
